summary: CSS can make a page easier or harder to use. Keep text contrast high, make click targets big enough, and never hide the keyboard focus outline.
notes: :focus-visible with no element before it applies to anything focused by the keyboard. Press Tab in the preview to move through the fields.
Gray hint text is only readable if it is dark enough. WCAG AA asks for a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1 for normal text.
Larger radio buttons (18px) are easier to hit with a finger or an unsteady mouse.
pitfall: Writing :focus { outline: none; } because the outline looks ugly. Keyboard users then cannot tell which field they are in.
